items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: It’s like they say Shakespeare only had twelve stories

ctx.x: Because they are statements. It’s like telling a story, you know, telling a story you see. And so it’s all there. It’s like talking all the time. A conversation. And like speaking on behalf of the grooves, in terms of expression, there is not one act of emotion or intellect, you just name it, that deals with life on this planet earth, that can’t be expressed with the blues.

With the blues. It’s like they say Shakespeare only had twelve stories, but that he was sort of like an astrologer, the twelve different signs you know, and each one has its own characteristics. So you could really—
